mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% from prior month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.0%, it indicates restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates and depresses valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, driving corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS increase by at least 0.5% from prior month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment and strong job growth regime (UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% in prior month), labor market strength supports consumer spending and corporate profits, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: low unemployment and strong job growth
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 105.0 (index 2017=100), it signals manufacturing contraction and supply chain weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 105.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong residential construction activity, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST increases by at least 0.5% from prior month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high consumer spending regime (RSAFS > 500,000 million), robust retail sales drive revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS > 500,000 million, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals labor market deterioration and reduced consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
